reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 7 points better, in a game of about 221 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Celtics.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Mavericks.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 71 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 195 and 244 total points.
